answer: Every key's pulse salary flows down one thread, fixed at minting, and any two keys sharing a thread must each post a pairwise lock into the grove, forfeit when either is proven fake — honest agents flee any thread holding an unproven key, so an operator must own and capitalize every clone itself. The k-th clone signs k new locks; the fleet freezes k(k−1)/2 × base pulse, escrowed so no pulse backs two locks at once. Fresh threads need an unrelated member to burn its one founding act per epoch, a bribe above that member's forfeitable stake, paid per head. A newcomer locks base once.
